A futuristic control panel frames a surreal vision inside a giant circular display, where a small figure faces an enormous blue robotic head beneath a star-filled sky. A tulip grows from the head's forehead, accompanied by floating orange shapes and a glowing droplet, while a black-and-white checkerboard path leads toward it. The keyboard, sliders and electronic controls suggest a meeting of music technology and imagined virtual worlds. Its retro-futuristic aesthetic, muted blue and orange palette, and dreamlike imagery evoke science fiction, video games and electronic exploration. RPG is the 2023 EP from Dutch producer and composer Shook (Jasper Wijnands), released on April 7, 2023 through his own label, Epicenter. He composed and recorded it entirely with one hand while healing from a broken arm, Nintendo soundtracks on repeat, drawing on retro video game music and 1980s Japanese environmental and ambient music. The limited edition 12-inch vinyl (EPI019) is available from his own Bandcamp store. https://shook.bandcamp.com/album/rpg #music #art #artwork #artist #fyp #albumartwork #albumcover #AlbumArt #MusicArtwork #synthesizer #retrofuturism #sciencefiction #illustration #robot

social.text: Auteur theory 🎬 Auteur theory holds that a film’s director is its ‘author’: the creative force whose personal style and recurring themes run through their work. It began with critics at Cahiers du Cinéma in 1950s France (Truffaut, Godard) and was named by American critic Andrew Sarris in 1962. Critics push back that filmmaking is collaborative. Both views matter. # Filmmaking # AuteurTheory # FilmTheory # FrenchNewWave # FilmHistory

social.author: @macwinstudios@mastodon.social
social.text: Isolation shot vs two shot 🎬 Isolation shot (a clean single): one character alone in the frame. It focuses us on their emotion and can make them feel alone. Two shot: both characters in frame. It shows distance, closeness and power between them, and lets us watch one react while the other acts. Most dialogue scenes mix both. Go to singles too early, and it turns into ping-pong. # Filmmaking # Cinematography # TwoShot # FilmTechnique # Coverage

social.author: @macwinstudios@mastodon.social
social.text: Comedic framing 🎬 Comedy isn’t just in the script. It’s in where you put the camera. Go wide so physical gags play out in full. Use a two-shot to show contrast between characters. Cut to the reaction, because the reaction is often the punchline. Hold the reveal outside the frame, then show it. Timing in the frame matters as much as timing in the performance. # Filmmaking # Cinematography # VisualComedy # FilmTechnique # Comedy

social.text: Chekhov’s gun 🎬 A storytelling principle from 19th-century Russian playwright Anton Chekhov: every prominent element in a story should be necessary. Often paraphrased as “if a gun appears in Act One, it should go off by Act Three.” In film it’s called “plant and payoff.” If a detail gets screen time, it should matter later. If it never does, cut it. # Filmmaking # Screenwriting # ChekhovsGun # Storytelling # FilmTechnique
